body.statement: Let \(\xi_n^0=(p_n/n,\gamma,\lambda,R)\), \(\widehat d_n=d(\widehat\xi_n)\), and \(I_\gamma=\mathbb E[Z^2\sigma(\gamma Z)\{1-\sigma(\gamma Z)\}]\). On every compact set \(K\subset(0,\kappa_{\mathrm{bal}})\times(\underline\gamma,\overline\gamma)\times(0,\infty)^2\) on which the four-distance map is continuously differentiable and \(\inf_{\xi\in K}\min\{d_{\mathrm{bal}}(\xi),d_{\mathrm{rad}}(\xi),d_{\mathrm{col}}(\xi),d_0(\xi)\}>0\), uniformly in \(\xi\in K\), \[\sqrt n\{\widehat d_n-d(\xi_n^0)\}\Rightarrow\mathcal N_4\!\left(0,\Omega(\xi)\right),\qquad \Omega(\xi)=\frac{\partial_\gamma d(\xi)\partial_\gamma d(\xi)^\top}{I_\gamma},\qquad \widehat\Omega_n\to_{\mathbb P}\Omega(\xi).\] Consequently, the simultaneous intervals \( [\widehat d_{\ell n}-\widehat u_{n,1-\alpha},\widehat d_{\ell n}+\widehat u_{n,1-\alpha}]\), \(\ell\in\{\mathrm{bal},\mathrm{rad},\mathrm{col},0\}\), have joint coverage at least \(1-\alpha+o(1)\) uniformly on \(K\), and \(\sup_{\xi\in K}\mathbb P_\xi\{\widehat s_{n,\alpha}\ne\operatorname{sgn}(\Delta_{\mathrm{HIR}}(\xi))\}\to0\), where any abstention counts as an error. Thus the classifier is total, reports \(\bot\) whenever any certificate is missing or any estimated boundary distance fails to exceed \(\widehat u_{n,1-\alpha}\), and is uniformly nonabstaining and sign-consistent on compact margin-separated sets.
body.justification: A deterministic diagram is operational only if its phase label can be learned from a trial away from nonregular boundaries.
body.gap: SurCandes2019 estimates scalar states for one logistic MLE and LuYangWang2025 estimates quadratic variance components; neither gives joint inference for a contrast of dependent optimized policy criteria.
body.consumer: The theorem supplies an uncertainty-aware label for whether entropy balancing improves or worsens targeting regret in a feature-expanded trial reanalysis.
